name: B10-0206/2026 (Renew) – The need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for action against cyberbullying and online harassment. It wants the European Commission to agree on a clear definition of cyberbullying and to check whether EU-wide criminal rules are needed, including for fake images made with artificial intelligence. It also asks for stronger enforcement of existing platform rules, better protection for children, and more digital literacy teaching in schools. This is a request, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for EU action, a shared definition and possible criminal rules.
- **Who it affects:** Children and young people online, plus social media platforms and EU governments.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states consider the requests; no new law is in force.
